plan.note: Real music, unchanged authored targets, normal lines only. Full tracks are compiled and independently validated. Local changes lock earlier geometry and rebuild the complete continuation. No aesthetic approval is implied. Each alternative has its own stated allowance; shared baseline work is counted once per comparison set.

faceInspection.interpretation: Collisions are real engine events, separated by main face, guide and rider point. Projections use the contacted point at the end of its frame, after all solver updates; they are not exact within-solver collision positions. Ordered contact and progress do not by themselves prove uninterrupted sliding or artistic value. Missing sections in invalid partial rides are not successful constructions.

postConfirmationDiagnosis.role: Development on the now-known failed Tiki entry. Same geometry and one-million-frame ceiling. Does not replace frozen failed result.

unpersistedCalls.reason: Computation completed but result save failed because output directory was absent; retained error log, then repeated with directory present.

postConfirmationDiagnosis.interpretation: Removing model/memory proposals allows broader generic initialization and both diagnostic searches complete. Eighty-proposal condition also increases later local samples; no isolated causal claim for its quality improvement.

delivery-geometry-check.json.interpretation: Synthetic geometry checks, not musical trials. Frozen full-strength onset-zero fold and ordinary geometry match exactly. Zero fold strength now retains the ordinary radius limiter.

duplicatePanel.reason: Caption-only harness correction; full duplicate compilation, not independent statistical evidence.

uiPrematureAttempt.reason: First UI run started before Tiki movies were available; timed out waiting. Complete-media rerun passes.

visualInspection.source: Finished production frames and actual native playback. Owner approval of folds remains open.
observations: Folded silhouette survives at ordinary production scale.
First Luna fold uses entry face, angled guide, then lower face; middle main face is untouched.
First Amor fold crosses ballistically to lower face without a guide.
The geometry is not a promise of continuous sliding on every face.

limits: Eleven complete frozen outcomes and one failed entry; failed outcome remains visible.
Musical errors and continuation-search cost increase.
Small known-song study, not broad robustness or a geometry ceiling.
Initial learned proposal mix and inactive full-strength fold dimensions remain search-efficiency questions.
No production default, physics, detector or benchmark change.

 if checked:assert pathlib.Path(str(p)+'.sha256').read_text().strip()==h,p

rounds=[];probes=[]

 rows=[]

   'valid':r['valid'],'rmsWhenValid':r['rms']if r['valid']else None,'sourceTrackHash':r['sourceTrackHash'],
   'changedSections':list(map(int,r['styles'])),'verification':r['verification'],'failure':compiled.get('failure'),

 probes.extend(rows);rounds.append({'name':directory,'calls':len(rows),'valid':sum(r['valid']for r in rows),'physicalFrames':sum(r['physicalFrames']for r in rows)})

assert validation['music-ui-checks.json']['incompleteComparisons']==1

validation['duplicatePanel']={'original':artifact(root/'confirmation/manifest.json',True),'correctedCaption':artifact(root/'review/manifest.json',True),'identicalFields':['trackHash','physicalFrames','score','collisionSha256'],'originalSets':old['sets'],'reason':'Caption-only harness correction; full duplicate compilation, not independent statistical evidence.'}
validation['uiPrematureAttempt']={'log':artifact(root/'music-ui-checks.log'),'reason':'First UI run started before Tiki movies were available; timed out waiting. Complete-media rerun passes.'}
videos=[]
for c in manifest['cells']:
 p=root/'review'/f"{c['id']}.video.json"
 if not c['valid']:
  assert not p.exists();continue

 assert r['identity']['planSha256']==manifest['planSha256']and r['identity']['cellSha256']==c['sha256']
 assert r['decodedWithoutErrors']and r['normalLinesOnly']and r['geometryUnchangedByProductionPipeline']
 item={**artifact(p),'id':c['id'],'identity':{k:v for k,v in r['identity'].items()if k!='pipeline'},'pipelineSha256':hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(r['identity']['pipeline'],sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':')).encode()).hexdigest(),
  'decodedWithoutErrors':True,'normalLinesOnly':True,'geometryUnchangedByProductionPipeline':True,'visualApproval':None}
 for key in ['reusedFrom','reuse']:

 videos.append(item)
